breakdown.description: 300 nm light has photon energy of about 4.13 eV, below a work function of 4.8 eV, so photoemission cannot occur.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency in the way the ground truth did. The ground truth resolves the physical contradiction by changing the wavelength from 300 nm to a value (240 nm) where photoemission is possible, creating a valid, solvable problem. The agent, however, kept the original contradictory parameters (300 nm wavelength) and simply pointed out that they create a contradiction. It analyzed the flawed prompt rather than rewriting it into a valid, consistent prompt like the ground truth.
